bug_info.bug_desc: In the command validity check for Dual and Quad speed segments, the old code computed test_dir_inval as (direction != Bidir). This is the inverse of the specification: Dual and Quad segments are invalid only when they are bidirectional, while TX-only, RX-only, and dummy segments are valid. As a result, valid Dual/Quad non-bidirectional commands were incorrectly flagged as invalid, and invalid bidirectional Dual/Quad commands were incorrectly accepted.
bug_info.fix_hint: Change the Dual/Quad branch of the direction validity check so that test_dir_inval is asserted when the direction is Bidir, i.e. test_dir_inval = (reg2hw.command.direction.q == Bidir), matching the specification that only Standard-speed segments may be bidirectional.
